info.title: Sponzey Fleet Controller API
info.summary: REST API for the Sponzey Fleet controller.
info.description: Sponzey Fleet exposes controller APIs for agent enrollment, inventory, job dispatch, snapshots, drift reports, and audit events. HTTP transport is supported only for local or short-lived tests. Use HTTPS for product, production, shared, or long-running environments because HTTP does not provide confidentiality or integrity.

source.description: Policy document source. The controller validates it before storing.
source.example:
apiVersion: fleet.sponzey.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: nginx-running
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      role: web
  checks:
    - id: nginx-service
      service:
        name: nginx
        state: running

runbook_document.description: Canonical v1alpha1 runbook YAML. If request target_agent_ids, selector, and matchLabels are all empty, the controller resolves targets from the selector or matchLabels inside this document. Supported safe primitives include port.check, process.check, facts.collect, and metrics.snapshot. Controlled mutation primitives include package, service, and file.copy.
runbook_document.example:
apiVersion: fleet.sponzey.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Runbook
name: nginx-basic
description: Install nginx and verify the local listener.
matchLabels:
  role: web
strategy:
  concurrency: 1
  maxFailures: 1
checkMode: false
dryRun: false
steps:
  - id: nginx-package
    package:
      name: nginx
      state: present
  - id: http-listener
    port.check:
      host: 127.0.0.1
      port: 8080

policy_document.example:
apiVersion: fleet.sponzey.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: nginx-running
spec:
  targets:
    selector: role=web
  checks: []

concurrency.description: Maximum number of assignments dispatched concurrently for one job. Omit for sequential fanout.

maxFailures.description: When this many assignment failures are reached, remaining queued assignments are canceled. Omit to keep dispatching queued targets.

selector.description: String selector. Supported forms are agent:<name-or-id>, label:key=value, or key=value[,key=value]. Cannot be combined with matchLabels.

matchLabels.description: Object label selector. All labels must match. Cannot be combined with selector.

message.example: 1 disabled or revoked agent(s) match the selector but will be excluded

selected_for_dispatch.description: False for disabled or revoked matches that are intentionally excluded from dispatch.

status.description: Initial job status. Approval-gated jobs return pending_approval.

approval_request_id.description: Approval request id when the job is pending approval. Null when the job is queued immediately.

reason.description: Creation reason for pending approvals, or approver decision reason for terminal approvals.

ApprovalDecisionRequest.description: Approval decision payload. The authenticated admin token determines the approver actor; the legacy actor field is accepted for compatibility but ignored.

actor.description: Deprecated compatibility field. The controller ignores this value and uses the authenticated admin actor.

cancel_delivered.description: True when the controller enqueued a task_cancel message to an active agent session. The database cancel state remains the source of truth even when this is false.

canceled_count.description: Number of queued, dispatched, accepted, or started assignments marked canceled by this request.

cancel_delivered_count.description: Number of active agent sessions that received a task_cancel message.

JobStatus.description: Domain job aggregate state. A single-agent job is treated as a multi-agent job with one assignment.

AssignmentStatus.description: Per-agent task assignment state. This is distinct from target agent connectivity status; output_received is an event, not an assignment state.

dispatch_state.description: Operator-facing dispatch state derived by the controller. It does not contain raw command output.

selector_kind.description: How the job target set was resolved: explicit_ids, selector, matchLabels, or resolved_ids.

selector_source.description: The original selector source persisted when the job was created.

target_connected.description: True when at least one target currently has an authenticated persistent session.

last_error.description: Controller-visible dispatch or terminal error summary. Raw stdout/stderr is only available through the output API.

skipped.description: Assignments canceled before dispatch because maxFailures was reached.

unknown.description: Targets whose assignment status is absent or not recognized.

concurrency.description: Maximum number of assignments the controller may dispatch concurrently for this job.

maxFailures.description: Failure threshold that cancels remaining queued assignments. Null means no threshold.

status.description: Operator-facing status derived from the target snapshot and current controller connection state.

snapshot_status.description: Agent status captured when the job target snapshot was created.

labels.description: Agent labels captured when the job target snapshot was created.

task_id.description: Task assignment id for this target. Null when no assignment exists in legacy or incomplete summaries.

assignment_status.description: Per-target assignment state. This is distinct from target connectivity status.

last_error.description: Redacted per-target assignment error summary. Raw stdout/stderr is only available through the output API.

Unauthorized.description: Admin token is missing or invalid.

Forbidden.description: The admin token is valid, but the authenticated admin actor does not have the required permission.

NotFound.description: The requested record was not found.

BadRequest.description: The request body or path parameter was invalid.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with an existing record or state.

post.description: This endpoint does not use the admin bearer token. The one-time enrollment token is provided in the request body.
The raw token is returned only once. Store it securely and do not log it.
Disables the current agent key. The agent is shown as offline and revoked and must be enrolled again with a new enrollment token.

get.description: Returns newest product-safe agent operational log chunks first. This stream is separate from command stdout/stderr, which is exposed through the job output API.

200.description: Latest drift report, or null when none exists.

Returns the controller-visible job status, dispatch state, target agent connection state, and metadata. Raw stdout/stderr is not embedded in this response.

post.description: Marks queued, dispatched, accepted, or started assignments as canceled. If the target agent has an active session, the controller also sends a task_cancel message. HTTP transport is test-only; use HTTPS for product or production environments.

post.summary: Preview selector targets before creating a job.
post.description: Uses the same selector resolution policy as job creation. Disabled or revoked agents are shown as matches but excluded from dispatch targets. Offline agents can be selected and remain queued until they reconnect.

Create a signed command job. Safe single-target commands queue immediately. High-risk commands and broad-target jobs return pending_approval with an approval_request_id and are not dispatched until approved.
Create a signed runbook job. Runbook execution is high risk and returns pending_approval with an approval_request_id until approved.
